Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: The client can end the contract immediately without notice and without paying you for completed work, leaving you uncompensated.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 30 days prior written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all Services performed and expenses incurred up to the effective date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work passes to the client upon delivery before you have been paid, exposing you if payment is delayed or withheld.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. I am looking forward to working together and would like to propose a few adjustments to the agreement before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning termination, the agreement currently allows ending the contract without notice or payment for completed work, so I propose changing this so that either party may terminate upon thirty days prior written notice with payment for all services performed. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning intellectual property, ownership currently transfers upon delivery before payment, so I propose that all intellectual property rights transfer to the client only upon receipt of full payment. Please let me know if these changes are acceptable to you. Best regards
